site_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, deliberately bare-bones desktop web app screenshot for Blueprint's signed-in SITE OPERATOR Overview. This is the approved visual reference we will implement in real HTML/CSS, so use precise realistic web typography and grids. 1440 x 1024 landscape. Match the supplied Blueprint sign-in screenshot's exact ivory #f6f5ef background, ink #22251e, forest green #203d2e, subtle #d7dcd0 rules, DM Sans humanist typography, small unrounded rectangular buttons and outlined square logo with the Blueprint wordmark. No dramatic art, marketing hero, shadows, gradients, purple, chart widgets, metric tiles, technical jargon or decorative icons. Restrained and beautiful through spacing, alignment and typography.
Layout: a 216 px left rail on the same ivory background, a fine vertical rule, square Blueprint logo at top; four text navigation links: Overview (active, pale green background and green text), Tasks, History, Settings. At bottom small organization label 'Acme Operations', then 'Site workspace' and a discreet 'Sign out'. Content from x=272 to x=1376. Top muted label 'Acme Operations'. Main heading 'Overview' in 42px regular DM Sans, a small forest button '+ Request a task' aligned right.
A quiet horizontal next-action strip, with top fine rule and bottom fine rule, at y=188: tiny uppercase 'UP NEXT', heading 'Capture visit', secondary 'Wednesday, September 16 · 10:00 AM CDT', muted 'In 3 days · Packing line, Austin', text link 'Manage visit →' at right. No countdown widgets or invented staff portraits.
At y=346 heading 'Your tasks' in 24px, small right link 'View all'. A simple editorial list of two task rows with thin horizontal dividers, NOT dashboards inside cards. Each row has a 112x90 soft photograph/illustration of a warehouse workcell on left, then task title, site/location, understated status, and compact real task criteria, then right-aligned action arrow. First row title 'Pack cartons into totes', second line 'Austin · Packing line', small pale green status 'Review results', third line '3 team results · 2 meet your targets', fourth muted line 'Target: ≥95% success · ≤30 sec per cycle', right text 'Review results →'. Second row title 'Move totes to staging', line 'Austin · Outbound', neutral status 'Capture scheduled', third line 'Capture Sep 16 · Targets agreed', right 'View task →'. Plenty of whitespace below. Footer tiny 'Illustrative data' so these synthetic examples are not customer claims. A calm operational product, not a marketing site. Keep everything readable and minimal.
robot_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design the ROBOT TEAM counterpart of the provided Blueprint site dashboard, preserving its exact design system, page geometry, typography, spacing, understated sophistication, ivory #f6f5ef background, forest green #203d2e, near-black #22251e and subtle rules. A bare-bones real web app screenshot at 1440x1024 landscape, not a marketing illustration. Keep the outlined square Blueprint logo and the same 216px left rail. Navigation: Overview (active), Openings, History, Settings. Bottom organization name 'Atlas Robotics', small 'Robot-team workspace', discreet 'Sign out'.
Content heading 'Overview', small organization label 'Atlas Robotics' above it, right primary button 'Browse openings →'. At y~180 a ruled next-action strip: small 'UP NEXT', heading 'Review your results', text 'Pack cartons into totes · Evaluation complete', secondary 'Your result is ready. The site has not selected a pilot team.', right text link 'View result →'.
Below heading 'Active evaluations', followed by a very clean spacious table with only thin horizontal dividers and no enclosing card. Columns 'Task', 'Your setup', 'Status', 'Your result', blank action. Row1 task 'Pack cartons into totes' with second line 'Fulfillment · Central Texas', setup 'Atlas M2 · Policy v4.2', status a pale-green 'Awaiting site decision', result '96% success' with second line '27 sec / cycle', right 'View →'. Row2 task 'Tote transfer' with subline 'Distribution · Midwest', setup 'Atlas M2 · Policy v4.3', neutral status 'Evaluation running', result 'Results pending', right 'View →'. Show no competitor names, scores, placements, rankings or totals.
Below a simple divided single-row section 'Ready for another task?' with short sentence 'Browse openings and evaluate a saved robot and policy.' and a text link 'Browse openings →'. No metric tile grid, no chart, no promotional art, no tool jargon. At footer tiny 'Illustrative data'. Keep readable type and ample whitespace; the same KISS product from the robot-team angle.
